import xlrd, math
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind
p='inputs/pone.0150501.s002.xls'
s=xlrd.open_workbook(p).sheet_by_name('RAW DATA')
names=[]; X=[]
for i in range(2,s.nrows):
 names.append(str(s.cell_value(i,0)))
 row=[]
 for j in range(1,s.ncols):
  v=s.cell_value(i,j)
  try: row.append(float(v))
  except: row.append(np.nan)
 X.append(row)
X=np.array(X)
samples=[s.cell_value(1,j) for j in range(1,s.ncols)]
print('shape',X.shape,'samples',samples)
print('NAs',np.isnan(X).sum(),'Ct>=34',np.sum(X>=34),'Ct<34',np.sum(X<34),'range',np.nanmin(X),np.nanmax(X))
print('NAs at',[(names[i],samples[j]) for i,j in zip(*np.where(np.isnan(X)))])
print('>=34 by sample',dict(zip(samples,np.sum(X>=34,axis=0))))

def adjust(p,method):
 p=np.asarray(p,float); m=len(p)
 if method=='bonf': return np.minimum(1,p*m)
 c=np.sum(1/np.arange(1,m+1))
 order=np.argsort(p); ps=p[order]
 q=ps*m*c/np.arange(1,m+1)
 q=np.minimum.accumulate(q[::-1])[::-1]
 q=np.minimum(q,1)
 out=np.empty(m); out[order]=q
 return out

def run(exclude=True,normdet=True,targetdet=False,equal=True, exp=False):
 Y=X.copy()
 if normdet:
  means=np.nanmean(np.where(Y<34,Y,np.nan),axis=0)
 else: means=np.nanmean(Y,axis=0)
 # log2 of 2"'^-deltaCt == -deltaCt. exp False chooses same.
 Y=-(Y-means)
 if targetdet: Y=np.where(X<34,Y,np.nan)
 keep=np.ones(len(samples),bool)
 if exclude:
  for z in ['"'P_3','C_18']: keep[samples.index(z)]=False
 pats=np.array([x.startswith('P_') for x in samples]) & keep
 ctrls=np.array([x.startswith('C_') for x in samples]) & keep
 pv=[]
 for row in Y:
  a=row[pats]; b=row[ctrls]; a=a[np.isfinite(a)]; b=b[np.isfinite(b)]
  pv.append(ttest_ind(a,b,equal_var=equal).pvalue)
 pv=np.array(pv)
 bon=adjust(pv,'bonf'); by=adjust(pv,'by')
 print('opts',exclude,normdet,targetdet,equal,'raw<=.05',sum(pv<=.05),'bon',sum(bon<=.05),'BY',sum(by<=.05),'min',names[np.argmin(pv)],pv.min(),bon.min(),by.min())
 ix=np.argsort(pv)[:8]
 for i in ix: print(' ',names[i],pv[i],bon[i],by[i])
for ex in [True,False]:
 for nd in [True,False]:
  for td in [False,True]:
   for eq in [True,False]: run(ex,nd,td,eq)

import xlrd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind,ttest_rel
s=xlrd.open_workbook('inputs/pone.0150501.s002.xls').sheet_by_index(0)
names=[s.cell_value(i,0) for i in range(2,s.nrows)]; samp=[s.cell_value(1,j) for j in range(1,s.ncols)]
X=np.array([[float(s.cell_value(i,j)) if isinstance(s.cell_value(i,j),(int,float)) else np.nan for j in range(1,s.ncols)] for i in range(2,s.nrows)])
keep=np.array([q not in ('P_3','C_18') for q in samp]); pat=np.array([q.startswith('P_') for q in samp])&keep; con=np.array([q.startswith('C_') for q in samp])&keep

def report(label,Y,test='ind',family=None):
 ps=[]
 for r in Y:
  a=r[pat];b=r[con];a=a[np.isfinite(a)];b=b[np.isfinite(b)]
  if test=='ind': p=ttest_ind(a,b,equal_var=True).pvalue
  else: p=ttest_rel(a,b,nan_policy='omit').pvalue
  ps.append(p)
 ps=np.array(ps); finite=np.isfinite(ps)
 if family is not None: finite &= family
 m=sum(finite); bon=np.where(finite,ps*m,np.nan)
 c=sum(1/np.arange(1,m+1)); ix=np.flatnonzero(finite); o=ix[np.argsort(ps[ix])]; by=np.full(len(ps),np.nan); q=ps[o]*m*c/np.arange(1,m+1); q=np.minimum.accumulate(q[::-1])[::-1];by[o]=q
 print(label,'m',m,'raw',sum((ps<=.05)&finite),'bon',sum(bon<=.05),'BY',sum(by<=.05),'min',names[np.nanargmin(bon)],np.nanmin(ps),np.nanmin(bon),np.nanmin(by))

# imputation and mean normalization variants
for nanfill in [34,35,40]:
 for cap in ['none','cap34','set34']:
  Z=X.copy(); Z[np.isnan(Z)]=nanfill
  if cap=='cap34': Z=np.minimum(Z,34)
  elif cap=='set34': Z[Z>=34]=34
  for meanmode in ['det','all','common']:
   if meanmode=='det': means=np.mean(np.where(Z<34,Z,np.nan),axis=0)
   elif meanmode=='all': means=np.mean(Z,axis=0)
   else:
    common=np.all(Z[:,keep]<34,axis=1); means=np.mean(Z[common],axis=0)
   Y=-(Z-means)
   report(f'fill{nanfill} {cap} {meanmode}',Y)
# family only miRNAs detected all kept samples; means det
means=np.nanmean(np.where(X<34,X,np.nan),axis=0);Y=-(X-means); common=np.all((X[:,keep]<34)&np.isfinite(X[:,keep]),axis=1)
report('family common det mean',Y,family=common)
# paired
report('paired det mean',Y,'paired')
PY"
